description:
Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

343583BR

City

Hong Kong SAR, Singapore

Key Responsibilities

Do you have a keen interest in working in a legal department? Do you have a background or desire to learn more about preparing, drafting, reviewing and negotiating simple contracts such as engagement letters or non-disclosure agreements? We are looking for someone to:

- Review and negotiate or assist with the negotiation of engagement letters and non-disclosure agreements in English and Chinese
- Prepare, review and assist with documentation relating to equity capital markets transactions, such as IPO ancillary documents, placing agreements, investor representation letters, disclaimers and case studies
- Prepare, review and assist with documentation relating to MTN (Medium Term Note) programmes or other securitized products
- Review Chinese versions of legal documentation
- Participate in internal special projects

The team

You’ll be part of the Legal Execution and Corporate Secretary team (“LECS”) in Singapore or Hong Kong, that provides high quality, timely, independent and cost-effective support for Group Legal. You will mainly assist the lawyers in the Global Banking legal team in Asia, who are responsible for advising our Global Banking colleagues on legal and regulatory matters related to the equity and debt capital markets services they offer to our clients across Asia. You will also be expected to work with other members of LECS and Group Legal in relation to a wide variety of legal and regulatory issues when required.

Your Skills And Experience

You have:

- a law degree
- ideally worked 2 years’ in a similar position before, either at a law firm or in an investment bank or wealth management environment
- the ability to multi-task
- a strong attention to details coupled with a solution orientated approach
- a willingness to learn and work a team player

You are:

- able to read and write in English and Chinese. Fluency in reading and writing Chinese is essential due to high volume of North Asia work.
- persistent in reaching defined objectives with stamina, initiative and drive
- able to handle pressure and used to working to deadlines
- comfortable in working in a dynamic and varied legal environment
- an excellent team player and as such an expert at building networks and connections and in communicating across rank and cultures
- you’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.
